eligible_conditions: Asymptomatic individuals with no signs or symptoms of lung cancer
Tobacco smoking history of at least 20 pack-years
Current smoker or one who has quit smoking within the last 15 years
exclusions: Individuals outside the age range of 50-77 years
Individuals with signs or symptoms of lung cancer
Individuals with a tobacco smoking history of less than 20 pack-years
Individuals who quit smoking more than 15 years ago
Screening without an order for lung cancer screening with LDCT
citations: NCD 210.14 - Lung Cancer Screening with Low Dose Computed Tomography (LDCT)
